name: Find The Pigs
desc:
🐷 Welcome to Find The Pigs! Search through the map and collect cute pigs!

Update:
Added 2 new pigs!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden pigs
🏃 Use sprint to complete obbies easier
🏆 Find all pigs to win!

Some pigs are very well hidden. Find pigs with friends and meet new friends along the way!

🐽 84 Pigs
🐗 5 Unique areas

If you want to suggest NEW pigs, post a message on the FindSquad group wall.
